statements.text: Assessment: right lumbar radiculopathy at L5-S1 due to disc herniation with foraminal stenosis.
MRI lumbar spine 08/18/2026: L5-S1 disc herniation with moderate right foraminal stenosis contacting the exiting nerve root.
Pain limits walking to about one block and has forced the patient to stop volunteering; sleep is disrupted most nights.
Symptoms began on 05/20/2026, 17 weeks before this visit.
PT discharge summary: completed 5 weeks of physical therapy (06/02/2026 to 07/07/2026) without meaningful improvement; meloxicam 15 mg daily for the same period without relief.
Continues the daily home exercise program taught in PT.
Denies fever, chills, weight loss, or bowel or bladder changes; no history of cancer.
Epidural steroid injection history: 1 lumbar injection in the past 12 months (05/24/2026).
